text: Love Island UK Season 12, Episode 51, featured the arrival of some of the Islanders' family members. Continuing from the previous episode, the saga of Islanders reuniting with their parents, cousins, and siblings went on. The latest episode began with the arrival of Helena and Blu's parents. Seeing her parents, Love Island UK star Helena got emotional. They also met fellow Islanders upon their arrival in the villa. The three had a conversation where Helena got emotional while recalling her connection with Harry. When her dad asked about her connection with him, she got emotional and said: The latest Love Island UK Season 12 episode featured an emotional reunion between Helena and her parents. She got emotional while reflecting on her time with Harry and the most recent recoupling . Helena's mom stated, After they went to sit and chat, her dad asked how long Helena had been in the villa. She said seven weeks. She confessed that it had been a bit of a rough week for her. Listening to Helena, her mom said, she had come out stronger. Helena then enquired, Her parents responded with yes. While her dad said he thought she was going to go back with Harry . Listening to him, Helena got emotional as she couldn't hold back her tears. Her dad asked her about it. She confessed that the connection from her side was "genuine" and "real". Love Island UK star couldn't stop her tears. Helena's mother comforted and told her that she was the winner. As her father mentioned how she "looked like" being a couple in her relationship, Helena responded: She talked about giving Harry another chance, which she did.
